lines.text: The priests, the temple guard captain and the Sadducees seized Peter and John and held them in custody until the next day.
Many who heard the message believed, and the number of men grew to about three thousand.
Filled with the Holy Spirit, Peter told the rulers the man stood healed by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth.
The council marveled that Peter and John had been with Gamaliel, and with the healed man standing there, they had nothing to say.
The believers asked for complete boldness to speak God's word, and after they prayed, their meeting place was shaken.
